21 CFR 82.1334 [1]: Specifies that D&C Red No. 34 is the calcium salt of 3-hydroxy-4-[(1-sulfo-2-naphthalenyl)azol-2-naphthalenecarboxylic acid.

21 CFR 82.1334 [2]: Requires that the sum of volatile matter (at 135 °C) and chlorides and sulfates (calculated as sodium salts) not exceed 15 percent.

21 CFR 82.1334 [2]: Requires that 2-amino-1-naphthalenesulfonic acid, calcium salt, not exceed 0.2 percent.

21 CFR 82.1334 [2]: Requires that 3-hydroxy-2-naphthoic acid not exceed 0.4 percent.

21 CFR 82.1334 [2]: Requires that subsidiary colors not exceed 4 percent.

21 CFR 82.1334 [2]: Requires that total color be at least 85 percent.

21 CFR 82.1050 [3]: A batch of a straight color listed in this subpart may be certified for use only in drugs and cosmetics if it conforms to § 82.5 and the specifications set forth in this subpart for such color.
